subject: Add AI-powered security scanner with multi-LLM support
body:
Add AI-powered security scanner with multi-LLM support

New feature: AI Security Scanner (Tools menu + right-click context menu)
- Collects comprehensive system security data:
  * OS version, configuration, and patch level
  * Running processes with paths and memory usage
  * Active network connections and open ports
  * Installed software with versions
  * Firewall status across all profiles
  * Local user accounts and security settings
  * Windows Update history
  * Network shares
  * Startup programs
  * Antivirus/security product status

- Sends data to LLM for expert security analysis
- Supports 4 LLM providers with configurable API key and model:
  * OpenAI (GPT-4o default)
  * Claude/Anthropic (Claude Sonnet default)
  * Google Gemini (Gemini 2.0 Flash default)
  * xAI Grok (Grok-3 default)

- LLM returns structured security report with:
  * Critical, High, Medium, Low risk findings
  * Specific CVE references where applicable
  * Actionable remediation steps with commands
  * Overall security score (1-10)

- UI features:
  * Dark-themed results panel with monospace font
  * Progress indicator during scan
  * Export report to file
  * Cancel support for long-running scans
  * Accessible from Tools menu and connection right-click menu

Co-authored-by: Ryan Lence <lenceai@users.noreply.github.com>

security_flags.reason: added code spawns a process or evaluates a string as code

triage.rationale: Out-of-scope security scanner that sends sensitive system info to external LLM APIs, presenting privacy risks.
